source: Dropbox /3D Amazing Debug/3D Amazing Help Videos

scripts.customers-add-customer: Open Customers and choose Add Customer. Enter the contact and business names, then save the Practice record.
scripts.inventory-receive-stock: Open the item's inventory controls. Enter the quantity received, apply the change, and confirm the new on-hand balance.
scripts.inventory-low-stock: Set the reorder level for an item. Then review the Low Stock report for flagged products.
scripts.quick-sale-create: Start a Quick Sale and select an example product. Choose the payment method, complete the sale, and review the receipt.
scripts.invoices-draft-and-finalize: Create an invoice for a Practice customer. Save a draft, then review the confirmation before finalizing it.
scripts.quotes-convert-to-invoice: Save a new quote. Choose Convert to Invoice, review the warning, and open the resulting invoice.
scripts.payments-record-payment: On Record Payment, choose an open invoice. Enter the amount, date, and method; save, then inspect the payment history.
scripts.reports-generate-export: Select the report and date range. Generate its preview, then use the export option to download the report.
scripts.events-create-and-manage: Create a Practice event, enter the details, and save. Reopen it to review or edit the event information.
scripts.business-settings-workspace-options: From Business Settings, review workspace choices. Sample Practice is separate from real Business; real processor connections are unavailable in Practice.
